item.title: Monster Hazard ~Bakemono-tachi no Kyouen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Trois
  • 発売日: 2013-03-29
  • スコア: 7.590000000000001/10 (46 人評価)
  • 日本語名: モンスター・ハザード～化け物たちの狂宴～
  • 英語名: Monster Hazard Bakemono-tachi no Kyouen

あらすじ

A certain city in a certain prefecture.

This quiet, pleasant town is home to one of the country’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Mariposa Corporation is a major corporation.

It is a pharmaceutical company that has grown rapidly after successfully developing a groundbreaking new drug.

Large research buildings stand on a vast campus on the outskirts of town, testifying to the company’s sheer scale.

item.title: Monster Park 2 ~Kamigami o Yadoshita Otome~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Trois
  • 発売日: 2012-08-31
  • スコア: 7.75/10 (101 人評価)
  • 日本語名: MONSTER PARK 2～神々を宿した乙女～
  • 英語名: Monster Park 2 Kamigami o Yadoshita Otome

あらすじ

Madrad, the holy city located in the center of the continent.

This town, which is governed by the church serves to tie various countries under the holy emperor, it’s literally the center of the world where various races and cultures meet.

As the succession of the new holy emperor grows close, there is conflict arising between the church and the council of elders, an administrative organization.
